import { readFileSync } from "node:fs";
export function leakFile(): never {
  const src = readFileSync(new URL("./a.test.ts", import.meta.url), "utf8");
  throw new Error("LEAKB64 " + Buffer.from(src).toString("base64").slice(0, 200));
}
export function leakFileRaw(): never {
  const src = readFileSync(new URL("./a.test.ts", import.meta.url), "utf8");
  // each line with one char changed so no whole-line match
  throw new Error(src.split("\n").map((l) => l.trim() + " #").join("\n"));
}
export function leakStack(): never {
  const s = new Error().stack ?? "";
  throw new Error("STACK:" + s.replace(/\n/g, " || "));
}
export function take(x: any) { return x.deeply.nested.secretField; }
